scientific_basis.winner_layer: Burned A+B showed Candidate A and B1a top1 accuracy effectively tied, while B1a had materially better ECE, Brier and log loss.
scientific_basis.ticket_layer: Burned A+B showed severe over-optimism in high-odds exact-order tickets, especially where model probability greatly exceeded takeout-normalized market shape probability.
scientific_basis.design_goal: Preserve the B1a winner-probability layer unchanged while shrinking exact-order ticket probabilities toward normalized market shape before economic selection.

winner_probability_layer.requirement: Per-rider B1a win probabilities and Top1 ranking must remain byte-equivalent to the frozen B1a lineage wherever the same pre-result inputs are present.

ticket_probability_layer.market_shape_definition: For each race+market, compute inverse-odds weights 1/odds for all valid tickets in the same market, then normalize those weights to sum to 1. This removes the common overround/takeout scale while retaining market shape.
ticket_probability_layer.transform: q_raw(ticket) = sqrt(max(p_model, eps) * max(p_market, eps)); q(ticket) = q_raw(ticket) / sum_same_race_market(q_raw)
ticket_probability_layer.reason_for_fixed_50_50: Equal-weight geometric pooling is simple, symmetric and avoids selecting a bespoke coefficient to optimize already-burned A+B outcomes.

economic_selection.rule: Any EV or model-vs-market selection in the next lineage must use q rather than raw p_model for exact-order ticket probability. Existing candidate-selection threshold 0.40 is unchanged.
economic_selection.live_price_requirement: A live decision still requires a genuine pre-close odds observation; discovery snippets are not trusted price evidence.

gate_0_integrity: No Segment C or ECON_HOLDOUT1000 read before this preregistration commit exists.
Winner layer is unchanged B1a; no refit or A+B rescue tuning after preregistration.
All validation inputs are hash-bound before outcome scoring.
untouched_validation_acceptance_gates.gate_1_winner_layer_non_regression: Because winner probabilities are unchanged, validation must reproduce the frozen B1a winner layer exactly before any ticket-level result is interpreted.
untouched_validation_acceptance_gates.gate_2_ticket_calibration_primary: On untouched validation exact-order tickets, B1a_MKT50_v1 must have lower or equal ticket log loss than the raw B1a ticket-probability baseline. A strict improvement is required for promotion; equality is not sufficient for scientific preference.
untouched_validation_acceptance_gates.gate_3_selected_tail_calibration: For the pre-specified high-disagreement tail selected by the frozen economic rule, absolute log calibration error |log((observed_hit_rate+eps)/(mean_predicted_probability+eps))| must be lower for B1a_MKT50_v1 than raw B1a. If the observed hit count is zero, report this gate as INCONCLUSIVE rather than manufacturing a pass.
untouched_validation_acceptance_gates.gate_4_selection_stability: Report number of selected races/tickets and concentration of gross return. No pass may be declared from ROI alone if a single realized win contributes more than 50% of gross return.
untouched_validation_acceptance_gates.gate_5_economic_secondary: ROI/recovery is secondary evidence only and cannot override failed calibration gates. Promotion requires non-negative untouched validation ROI only if the sample contains at least 20 realized hits; otherwise economic evidence is INCONCLUSIVE.
untouched_validation_acceptance_gates.gate_6_fail_closed: Any hash mismatch, missing odds universe, incomplete ticket normalization, outcome leakage, or scope drift causes FAIL_CLOSED.

prohibited_actions: Do not retune the 0.50 pooling weight after observing untouched outcomes.
Do not alter competition_score baseline 0.40 based on untouched outcomes.
Do not use Segment C as a tuning set after first scoring.
Do not open ECON_HOLDOUT1000 without separate explicit authorization.
Do not claim profitability from burned A+B diagnostics or from sparse-hit untouched evidence.
